links.outcome: Model performance and calibration under synthetically degraded chest X-ray inputs
links.effect: All models showed statistically significant degradation; motion blur reduced sensitivity by up to 21%; expected calibration error rose from about 0.04 to over 0.10 under degradation.
links.quote: Motion blur was the most detrimental artifacts, causing sensitivity reductions of up to 21%.

screen.reason: Empirical robustness benchmark evaluating AI performance under simulated real-world image degradation, highlighting failure modes without testing a specific operational guardrail or intervention.
